entries.heading: Simi Valley Pioneers - Chad
entries.narrative: - He lives in Illinois. Oakland Raider fan. Chad joined us in 2008 and has been a solid owner for this team. He has won 2 SuperBowls with 4 Playoff appearances. He has been to 4 JaMarcus Russell Bowls and won 3 of those as well. He holds a record for the Most points for a Defensive Rookie at 204. He has 2 Offensive Rookie of the Year in Seasons 3 & 5 (Matt Forte and Dez Bryant) and 2 Defensive ROYs in Seasons 3 & 7 (Jerod Mayo and Lavonte David). Tough competitor but overvalues his players for our league. Tries to trade players for their name value for top young players even though they have lost a step or several. Currently Chad is sitting in 6th with overall wins.

entries.heading: Highland Park Giants - Scott
entries.narrative: - He lives in Denver, Colorado. Scott loved the league and was very active but had too many leagues. He only stuck around 1 season but wanted to stay longer. He had emailed me that he was staying just don't tell my wife. I think she found out. An 8-11 season was all we got out of him. No Playoffs. No Records or Awards. Barely knew he was here.

entries.heading: *Hennessey Eagles - Aaron
entries.narrative: - He lives in Ardmore, Oklahoma. He played just the 1st season with us and finished 12-7 and made the Playoffs (0-1) but lost to Cathedral right away.
